rationale: Use the registered pocket family without overrides: the evidence establishes receptor geometry but does not support ranking parameter values. Coordinate targets originate in the original receptor crop around the standard FLOWR input site; contact and exclusion targets are registered geometric heuristics. They require receptor coordinates, with no generated Steer, elite history, lineage, or bound-ligand reward template. Preserve the matched seed, steps, window and native RMS ratio 0.33. This is an untested geometric proxy for the predicted pIC50 objective, with no statistical affinity support. Compute spatial gradients through FLOWR endpoint VJP, detach any correspondence, and never substitute time derivatives.
failure_modes: Untyped contact attraction can crowd inaccessible regions or favor chemically incompatible contacts; improved geometry does not establish affinity improvement.
Aggregate receptor statistics cannot locate accessible contact sites or resolve chemical complementarity; short protein-neighbor distances are not ligand clashes.
No affinity labels or comparative outcomes support an optimal update; single-seed evaluation remains exploratory.
Component-weight changes can alter gradient direction, while whole-scalar rescaling may cancel under gradient normalization.
An incorrect endpoint VJP or non-detached correspondence can distort spatial steering; time derivatives do not provide spatial gradients.
